page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-24-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4n family. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs and 90.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes local NVMe SSD storage, though the specific capacity is not defined in the primary storage size metrics. It does not include any GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, this instance provides predictable compute resources without the virtualization overhead of shared-core models. The vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this server as a balanced option for workloads requiring a steady allocation of processing power and memory. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated hardware profile offers a stable resource-to-cost ratio for sustained workloads, avoiding the performance variability associated with burstable instances.

This hardware configuration is suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded applications, web serving, and moderate database operations that benefit from dedicated vCPUs and local NVMe SSD storage.
